text: OVERDOSAGE Itraconazole is not removed by dialysis. There are limited data on the outcomes of patients ingesting high doses of itraconazole. In patients taking either 1000 mg of SPORANOX ® (itraconazole) Oral Solution or up to 3000 mg of SPORANOX ® Capsules, or b.i.d. dosing for four days with SPORANOX ® Injection, the adverse event profile was similar to that observed at recommended doses.
